name: s81ctrl_rg3s-rg3s-COMMIT
purpose: S81 CTRL rg3 (MU.BAL.SX.3): n32s controller + non-inline index reader client face (rrq/rrd), fallback side-face pins

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_ctrl_rg3 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DS81CTRL_SRAM_FIFO -DS81CTRL_SRAM_P192 -DS81CTRL_NATIVE32 --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_afifo.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/ot_s81ph_afifo_g.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/ot_s81ph_ctrl_pcr.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/dsfd_rly_masters_dv276.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/ot_s81ph_afifo_g_sram.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x340_p192/ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x340_p192_bb.v rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/dsfd_ctrl_rg3.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg3s/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg3s/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg3s --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_ctrl_rg3 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x340_p192 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: DRIVE-S81-IDX4-KITS 10-20 (MU.BAL.SX.3, mu7i4 die): dsfd_ctrl_rg3 = dsfd_ctrl_rg2 (same 2 x ot_s81ph_ctrl_pcr, n32s defines SRAM p192 FIFOs + native32, same 388.8 x 324 outline, same 2x2 SRAM macro origins) PLUS the static-slot client face of the non-inline index reader dsdv_idx_rg3: rrq 92 b in / rrd 544 b out (landing FIFO 24 x 44 b a PC in flops, return demux by reader tag, registered slot select). +3.6k FF (6583 vs 2956), census 0 drivers > 32 (reset landing by the flow). Pin plan: n32s pins unchanged; rrq (92) on the W face, rrd (544) on the E face (M4, <= 1.7 pins/um).
